summary: {{1–3 lines: what the story, bug fix, or testcase delivers and why}}

acceptance_criteria.text: {{acceptance criterion, expected bug behavior, or behavior to cover}}

exact_source_files.anchor: {{class / function / method / component touched, or empty for a new file}}
exact_source_files.change: {{what changes in this file, in one or two plain sentences}}
exact_source_files.reason: {{why this file: the anchor, endpoint, stack trace, or pattern that points here}}

ac: {{AC ids covered by this test file}}

adjacent_dependencies.path: {{path of a caller / consumer / contract that is NOT modified}}

implementation_steps: {{1. ordered step naming the file it touches}}
assumptions: {{assumption the plan makes that the developer should confirm, or empty}}
risks: {{at least one line, always: level + why + rollback, e.g. Low: isolated guard clause; rollback = revert one file}}
scope_override_reason: {{empty, or why the slice needs more than 5 source files / 3 test files}}
constraints: {{constraint, one short sentence; answered questions as "Q<n>: <question in a few words> → <answer>"}}
build_commands: {{narrowest build / compile / type-check command for the slice, or NOT_CONFIGURED}}
unit_test_commands: {{narrowest unit-test command for the slice, or TO_BE_CONFIGURED}}

analyzer_commands: {{configured static analysis / lint command for the touched files, or NOT_CONFIGURED}}

findings.id: {{<WORK-ID>-R<n>; once RESOLVED, only id, rule, severity, status (and decided_via) are kept}}
findings.rule: {{rule id from standards/code-review-standards.md or a standard that applies to the file, e.g. CR-SIZE-01}}
findings.problem: {{one sentence, with the measured value when there is one}}
findings.decided_via: {{exact command that approved or waived it, e.g. /fix-bugs STORY-12 approve R1, or empty}}

missing_facts: {{fact missing from local work cache or empty}}

unresolved_questions.question: {{question for the developer, or remove the entry when none}}

plan_review.approved_via: {{exact command, e.g. /implement-story STORY-12 approved, or empty}}
